parsed.explanation: No traveler-facing exposure is documented: no trans criminalisation, no facility/birth-sex rule, no border screening, foreign documents govern identity throughout. That rules out tiers 1-2. Positives are real but mostly LGB-facing climate signals: long decriminalisation, civil unions, a constitutional non-discrimination clause, an openly gay head of state, and LGBTQ-inclusive curricula — evidence of a tolerant society a visitor enters. The trans-specific record is thinner: no legal gender recognition (resident gap only), hate-crime/sentence enhancements cover sexual orientation but not gender identity despite accepted 2019 UPR recommendations, and anti-LGBTQ violence is reported only occasionally with no figures or general-crime comparison — so neither patterned targeting nor baseline can be established. No documented police extortion, service denial scale, or custody/ward placement rule. Residual uncertainty (custody, care, unquantified friction) keeps it below the 0.85 band.
